race.comment: MAGICAL SEQUENCE (12) returned with a new peak rating, scoring by 0.4L at this track. Out to 1400m is no issue and Pike sticking with her is a big tick for her chances. May need some luck from the draw, but she's a progressive talent who can keep working through the grades. SUPERNATURAL (10) missed by 0.8L at this track and trip last time out when closing well second-up. Fitter again now and can go one better. ZOURUN RUN (15) won narrowly two back and then had no luck last time out when beaten by MAGICAL SEQUENCE. Has a few things against her this time out to 1400m for the first time, but she's a progressive talent and can't be discounted. MT SHIRATAKU (9) bounced back in a big way last time out when leading throughout to score by 0.8L. Firmer footing again here is a big tick and while he has drawn wide, he has the talent to overcome that. CHARINO (1) can bring up the hat-trick without surprising.
